<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="trayGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9747FF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1B0188"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="-3" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#DCDCDC" flood-opacity="0.75"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="22" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">9:41</text>
    <line x1="323" y1="15" x2="323" y2="21" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="12" x2="328" y2="21" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="333" y1="9" x2="333" y2="21" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="347" cy="16" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="344" y1="20" x2="350" y2="20" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="10" width="20" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="363" y="12" width="14" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#110053"/>
    <rect x="382" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Light loading area -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="136" r="46" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="136" r="31" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="105" x2="195" y2="113" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="159" x2="195" y2="167" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="164" y1="136" x2="172" y2="136" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="218" y1="136" x2="226" y2="136" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="173" y1="114" x2="179" y2="120" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="211" y1="152" x2="217" y2="158" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="217" y1="114" x2="211" y2="120" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="179" y1="152" x2="173" y2="158" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Pig illustration -->
  <g>
    <path d="M153 252 C145 240 146 225 157 218 C168 211 179 216 184 227 C177 232 172 241 171 252 Z" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <path d="M237 252 C245 240 244 225 233 218 C222 211 211 216 206 227 C213 232 218 241 219 252 Z" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="264" rx="55" ry="48" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <circle cx="174" cy="252" r="5" fill="#110053"/>
    <circle cx="216" cy="252" r="5" fill="#110053"/>
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="281" rx="25" ry="17" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="186" cy="280" r="4" fill="#9747FF"/>
    <circle cx="204" cy="280" r="4" fill="#9747FF"/>
    <path d="M176 295 C185 303 205 303 214 295" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M151 270 C143 279 142 290 150 297" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="354" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Estamos procesando tu viaje</text>
  <text x="195" y="381" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Esto puede tardar unos segundos</text>

  <!-- Loading tray -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="0" y="432" width="390" height="412" rx="30" fill="url(#trayGradient)"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="164" y="450" width="62" height="5" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.72"/>

  <text x="30" y="502" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Casi listo</text>
  <text x="30" y="529" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9">Estamos buscando las mejores opciones</text>

  <!-- Progress indicator -->
  <g>
    <rect x="30" y="556" width="330" height="8" rx="4" fill="#110053" opacity="0.55"/>
    <rect x="30" y="556" width="205" height="8" rx="4" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <circle cx="235" cy="560" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Fare reminder card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="29" y="594" width="332" height="105" rx="14" fill="#110053" opacity="0.55"/>
    <circle cx="59" cy="626" r="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="59,615 62,623 71,623 64,628 67,637 59,632 51,637 54,628 47,623 56,623" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <text x="88" y="622" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Recuerda tu tarifa</text>
    <text x="88" y="646" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">La tarifa seleccionada incluye</text>
    <text x="88" y="666" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">equipaje de mano y selección de asiento.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Helpful travel information -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="48" cy="738" r="15" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
    <text x="48" y="744" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="75" y="735" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Consejo de viaje</text>
    <text x="75" y="758" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9">Ten tus documentos a mano para continuar.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <line x1="18" y1="782" x2="372" y2="782" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-opacity="0.25"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="42,806 52,797 62,806 62,816 55,816 55,809 49,809 49,816 42,816" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <text x="52" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Inicio</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="130" cy="805" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="137" y1="812" x2="144" y2="819" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="130" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Buscar</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="207" y="797" width="22" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="211" y1="802" x2="225" y2="802" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="211" y1="806" x2="221" y2="806" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="218" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Viajes</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="310" cy="802" r="7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <ellipse cx="310" cy="815" rx="13" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="310" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Cuenta</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
